<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/hostname"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sets the static hostname with hostnamectl set-hostname, which keeps it after a reboot. A host that already has the name does not change and reports changed: false. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped. In a container the runtime owns the hostname, so there it also reports skipped.
